findings.value: The council calls it fully inclusive, with equipment for young people aged 8 to 25 who have additional needs (SEND). The council says you can turn up without booking, though places are limited. Step-free access is not stated.

evidence.quote: Fully inclusive adventure playground. All equipment in this playground is accessible to children and young people with additional needs aged 8 – 25 (SEND)
There is no need to book, but spaces are limited.

findings.value: Adventure play for ages 5 to 15 in term time; children under 8 must be accompanied by an adult

evidence.quote: Adventure play sessions for ages 5 to 15, Tuesday to Thursday, 3:30 – 6pm (term time only).
Children below the age of 8 must be accompanied by an adult at all times.

notes: Council parks directory is the only source found. It is run by the council on behalf of the King George's Field, Mile End Charity. The directory also lists a play area for ages 4 and below and a multi-use games area. The session times on the directory page are general; the one-off half-term session on the council events page (27 October 2026) is not a profile fact. Its postcode is not on this page, and the events page prints 'E1 ONZ', which is not a valid postcode, so none is proposed. No own website found: one WebSearch returned only council pages, so website is not proposed.
